description: Estimated due date, current gestational age (weeks+days), trimester and days left. method lmp (last menstrual period, default), conception, ivf3, ivf5 (embryo transfer date) or us (ultrasound date with us_weeks/us_days). The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

cycle.description: Cycle length days (21-45), default 28; lmp only

date.description: LMP, conception, transfer or ultrasound date (YYYY-MM-DD)

locale.description: Page language for links, e.g. en, ko, ja, es, de. Default en; falls back to English when a tool has no page in that language.
